$comment: GENERATED sites and builds by scripts/features/env_audit.py --write; class, effect and followup are reviewed by hand. Queries: app = "CMUX_*" literals in Packages/macOS/CmuxNext/Sources/**/*.swift, daemon = "CMUX_TUI_*" literals in cmux-tui/crates/**/*.rs.

classes.releasePerf: Read in a shipped build (Release or Nightly) and changes a perf path (latency, frames, memory, threads, process model). Open until it is a feature in schemas/features/features.d/ or its read moves under #if DEBUG / cfg(debug_assertions).
classes.releaseProbe: Read in a shipped build only to add measurement for a bench, a trace or a report; unset in normal use, and it changes no product behavior (Chromium's --enable-benchmarking and --trace-startup).
classes.releaseConfig: Read in a shipped build; selects identity, paths, sockets, channel, auth, a test harness's placement or another non-perf behavior.
classes.releaseTestHook: Read in a shipped build as a test seam (fault injection or a shorter bound) that does nothing unless set and touches no perf path. Prefer cfg(debug_assertions) when the tests allow it.
classes.childEnv: Set, passed on or stripped for a child process or a shell; this process does not branch on it.
classes.debugOnly: Every site compiles only into Debug or bench builds (#if DEBUG, #if DEBUG || CMUX_BENCH_HOOKS, cfg(debug_assertions)) or tests.
classes.testOnly: Every site is test code (cfg(test), #[test], tests/, benches/).
classes.notEnv: The literal is not an env name the process reads: a prefix, a key in a document, a list of names to strip, docs.
